disclaimer: This travel checker is for informational purposes only. Visa policies, exemptions, and passport requirements change frequently. Philippine citizens must always confirm the latest travel rules with the official embassy of their destination country or the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) before booking travel.

entryRequirements.title: Passport 6-Month Validity
entryRequirements.description: Your Philippine passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your planned date of departure from your destination country.

entryRequirements.title: Philippine Travel Tax
entryRequirements.description: Philippine citizens departing for international travel must pay the Travel Tax (generally PHP 1,620 for economy/tourist class) online or at the airport before boarding.

entryRequirements.title: Outbound e-Travel
entryRequirements.description: All departing Filipino citizens must register online at the official e-Travel portal (etravel.gov.ph) within 72 hours before their flight out of the Philippines.

entryRequirements.title: Immigration Inspection Documents
entryRequirements.description: Immigration officers may request proof of your employment (ID, COE), return ticket, hotel reservation, and financial capability to ensure compliance and prevent offloading.

importantVisaInfo.title: Schengen Visa (Europe)
importantVisaInfo.description: For travel to most European Union countries, Filipinos must apply for a Schengen Visa. Applications should be submitted through accredited service providers (like VFS Global or BLS International) at least 15 days, and up to 6 months, before departure.

importantVisaInfo.title: US Non-Immigrant Visa (B1/B2)
importantVisaInfo.description: Filipinos traveling to the United States require a B1/B2 Tourist/Business Visa. This requires completing the online DS-160 application form, paying the fee, and scheduling an in-person interview at the US Embassy in Manila.

importantVisaInfo.title: Returning to the Philippines
importantVisaInfo.description: Upon your return trip to the Philippines, all passengers (including returning Filipino citizens) must register on the e-Travel portal within 72 hours prior to arrival. Keep your QR code ready for quarantine and immigration clearance.
importantVisaInfo.note: Re-entry checklist: Register inbound on e-Travel within 72 hours of your flight back to the Philippines.

visaTypes.description: Common visa classes that Filipino passport holders apply for when traveling internationally.

items.name: Visa-Free Entry or Electronic Travel Authorization
items.description: Allows Philippine citizens to enter without a pre-approved embassy visa for short stays (usually 14-30 days), sometimes requiring an online registration (eTA) prior to boarding.

items.name: Electronic Visa (e-Visa)
items.description: An online visa application process where approval is received digitally (PDF) rather than a physical stamp or sticker in the passport.

items.name: Visa on Arrival (VoA)
items.description: Allows travelers to apply and pay for a tourist visa upon landing at the destination country's airport or border checkpoint.

items.name: Consular / Embassy Sticker Visa
items.description: Requires submitting physical application forms, original passport, photos, and extensive financial documents directly to the destination country's embassy in Manila or their official visa center (e.g. VFS Global).

visaTypes.description: Required credentials for Filipinos working, studying, or moving abroad.

items.name: Overseas Employment Certificate
items.description: A mandatory exit clearance issued by the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) to Filipino workers (OFWs) departing to work abroad, exempting them from travel tax.

items.name: International Student Visa
items.description: Issued by foreign governments for pursuing full-time studies or vocational courses. Usually requires acceptance letters, health certificates, and proof of financial sponsorship.

countries.name: United States
countries.requirements: Philippine passport holders must apply for a visa at the US Embassy in Manila, submit DS-160, pay the fee, and schedule an interview.

countries.name: Japan
countries.requirements: Visa application must be filed through accredited travel agencies. E-Visa system available for single-entry tourist visas under specific travel agencies.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.requirements: Visa application through designated travel agencies. E-Group visa is available for official tour groups.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.requirements: Valid Philippine passport, return/onward ticket, and SG Arrival Card (SGAC) online registration within 3 days prior to arrival.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.requirements: Online application via UK Visas and Immigration, biometric appointment at VFS Global Manila/Cebu, and extensive financial documentation.

countries.name: Australia
countries.requirements: Online application via ImmiAccount. No physical label; visa is digitally linked to the passport.

countries.name: Canada
countries.requirements: eTA eligible if holding valid US non-immigrant visa or held Canadian visa in last 10 years. Otherwise, Visitor Visa required.

countries.name: Germany
countries.requirements: Apply at the German Embassy (via VFS Global Manila). Valid for transit and tourism across the entire Schengen zone.

countries.name: France
countries.requirements: Apply at the French Embassy (via VFS Global Manila). Valid for transit and tourism across the entire Schengen zone.

countries.name: Italy
countries.requirements: Apply at the Italian Embassy (via VFS Global Manila). Valid for transit and tourism across the entire Schengen zone.

countries.name: Spain
countries.requirements: Apply at the Spanish Embassy (via BLS International Manila). Valid for transit and tourism across the Schengen zone.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.requirements: Apply at the Netherlands Embassy (via VFS Global Manila). Valid for travel across the Schengen zone.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.requirements: Apply at the Swiss Embassy (via VFS Global Manila). Valid for travel across the Schengen zone.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.requirements: Online application via Immigration New Zealand portal. No physical sticker is placed on passport.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.requirements: Valid passport, return ticket, and Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) registration.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.requirements: Valid passport, return ticket, and Satusehat Health Pass online registration.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.requirements: Valid passport, return ticket, and proof of sufficient funds (10,000 THB per person, or 20,000 THB per family).

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.requirements: Valid passport and return/onward ticket.

countries.name: Brunei
countries.requirements: Valid passport, return ticket, and E-Arrival Card registration.

countries.name: Hong Kong
countries.requirements: Valid passport and return ticket. Mandatory Arrival Card declaration.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.requirements: Valid passport, return/onward ticket, proof of hotel booking, and online arrival card registration.

countries.name: China
countries.requirements: Apply at Chinese Embassy in Manila. Requires submission of invitation letter or detailed flight and hotel itineraries.

countries.name: India
countries.requirements: Apply online at official Indian e-Visa portal at least 4 days prior to travel.

countries.name: Russia
countries.requirements: Apply online on Russian MFA portal at least 4 days before travel. Single entry only.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.requirements: Apply for a tourist visa via accredited agencies, or online e-Visa if holding valid US/Schengen visa and traveling via Saudi airlines.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.requirements: Apply for tourist visa at the Nigerian Embassy in Manila.
